name: dsh-plugin-weapp-gateway
description: Authenticated mobile gateway for dsh 0.1.7-rc.2 with Session V4 history, live permissions, inbox-based queue sync, plugin management (DSH 0.2.0 hosts), LAN and Cloudflare Tunnel access with public endpoint health checks, device pairing, per-session Agent preset selection, relay access for the WeChat mini-program, and the official speech-input bridge (speech-input-v1)
